description: SMALL_ACCOUNT_PAPER scanning universe: the original 14 plus liquid underlyings whose options passed the UNCHANGED strategy contract filters within a $400 budget. Not part of strategy.txt; the strategy hash is unaffected.
selection_criteria: complete DXLink 1-minute history for the session so far (no missing or out-of-order candles)
option chain with quotes and delta/gamma/theta for every quoted near-the-money contract
at least one contract passing the strategy's own filters (7-21 DTE, |delta| 0.45-0.65, spread <= $0.10 and <= 10%, OI >= 100, volume >= 10) at <= $400 modeled risk

capacity.measured: 47 quote snapshots/minute at 10 req/s with GET-only 429 retry: 47/47 ok for 3 consecutive minutes, slowest 8.0s (quote freshness limit 20s). Without pacing ~1/3 were refused with HTTP 429.
